meta_title: Payna — Your phone is the terminal
meta_description: Payna turns an ordinary Android phone into a payment terminal for Moroccan merchants — tap to get paid, a digital credit carnet with SMS reminders, and daily sales figures, in Darija, Amazigh, French and English, for 49 MAD a month.
hero_description: Payna turns an ordinary Android phone into a payment terminal for Moroccan merchants — tap to get paid, a digital credit carnet with SMS reminders, and daily sales figures, in Darija, Amazigh, French and English, for 49 MAD a month.
pay_title: Enter the amount. Hand over the phone. Done.
pay_body: No terminal to rent, no box on the counter. The phone the merchant already owns takes the payment, and the customer sees the amount before they tap.
pay_p1: A receipt every time — printed, or shared on WhatsApp.
pay_p2: Refunds, in full or in half, from the transaction list.
pay_p3: Every transaction kept: what was paid, when, and what came back.
credit_body: Every neighbourhood shop keeps a notebook of who owes what. Payna keeps it for you: each customer, each debt, each payment against it — and the total, always current.
credit_p1: One list, every balance, never out of date.
credit_p2: Register a payment against a debt in two taps.
credit_p3: SMS reminders — sent when you decide, not by themselves.
analytics_body: Today, this week, this month — the totals a merchant actually asks for, on the screen they already have open.
analytics_p3: Payments and refunds counted separately, so the net is the net.
lang_body: Darija, Amazigh, French and English — chosen on the first screen, in the merchant's own words, not a translation of someone else's app.
pricing_free_rule: Free if you don't reach 500 MAD revenue in 30 days.
pricing_how: Activate for free, use everything. If your revenue exceeds 500 MAD in 30 days, 49 MAD is deducted automatically.
inc_2: Sales and analytics — daily, monthly and yearly reports
inc_5: Credit — track debts and SMS alerts
inc_6: Custom receipt — with your logo and shop name
